title: Benefits and opportunities from the Strategic Food Partnership with New Zealand
asked: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin asked what are the benefits for Singaporeans and opportunities for Singapore businesses as part of the Strategic Food Partnership with New Zealand.
response: The Strategic Food Partnership with New Zealand, launched in October 2025, aims to strengthen food cooperation in agri-food trade and supply chains, regulations and standards, biosecurity, and research and innovation. It complements the Agreement on Trade in Essential Supplies, under which both sides can continue to receive essential supplies, including food items, during supply chain disruptions. The ministry is exploring expanding the regionalisation arrangement for Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza to include African Swine Fever and Foot and Mouth Disease, which would minimise trade disruptions during animal disease outbreaks. It will also look at facilitating greater food trade through exchanges between public and private sector stakeholders to identify pain points and explore solutions and commercialisation and investment opportunities.
